description: Set an effect parameter on clips to one value (not animated). An animated parameter keeps its keyframes unless clearKeyframes is true. Values: numbers, text, true/false, points { x, y }, colours { red, green, blue, alpha } from 0 to 1. One undo step

clearKeyframes.description: Turn animation off first (removes the parameter's keyframes). Default false

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

param.description: Parameter name as list_clip_effects reports it, e.g. "Scale"

paramIndex.description: Parameter index instead of a name

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

value.description: A number, text, true/false, a point { x, y }, or a colour { red, green, blue, alpha } with channels from 0 to 1

name: set_effect_param
title: Set Effect Param
